name: sk-chat-bubble
title: Chat Bubble
description: A message bubble whose body and tail are one continuous path, so a border follows the silhouette instead of running around two shapes. Consecutive messages group: corners tighten on the sender's side and only the last bubble keeps its tail. Carries sending, sent and failed states, with retry on failure.
author: Ahmed Gagan
usage:
SKChatBubble("Did the migration finish?", role: .user)
SKChatBubble(reply, role: .assistant, position: .last, timestamp: date)
